notes: Currency is unresolved: 'Net price' values carry a '$' symbol (e.g. $1234.56) while the target schema defaults /currency to THB. Currency must not be inferred from the symbol or from the file's locale; amounts are mapped without FX conversion and the currency question is left open for confirmation (ISO code).
SKU values are zero-padded text ('00470001'). The column was profiled as int-like, but mapping must read it as text so leading zeros are preserved; /sku is emitted as a string.

Tax rate 5% is a fixture value stated in the source column; it is used as the price's vat_rate only because it is explicitly present on each row. /prices/*/vat_included comes from the explicit 'Tax included = No' column, not from retail convention.

No date, warehouse, stock, promotion, category, brand, barcode or description columns exist in this file, so /prices/*/effective_from, effective_to, /inventory, /promotions, /category, /brand, /barcode and /description stay unmapped rather than fabricated.

Because the sheet holds one price per SKU, the /prices collection will contain exactly one item per product keyed by price_list 'standard'; if additional price lists exist in other exports they would be reconciled separately.

tables.reason: Sheet 'export' is a flat one-row-per-item export: unique SKU (12 rows, 12 distinct), unique product name, a single sales unit (PCS), a single price list ('standard'), a price column ('Net price'), and per-row VAT flags (Tax included = No, Tax rate = 5%). This is the product master flat file with an inline single price record per SKU, matching the Product contract (sku + product_name required, /prices collection with price_list/amount/vat_included).

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU' is the primary key synonym; unique per row (12/12) and values print as '00470001'…'00470012', i.e. zero-padded text identifiers. Must be cast to string so leading zeros survive (no strip_leading_zeros, no numeric cast).

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header 'Product name' is a direct synonym of product_name; 12 distinct free-text values (e.g. 'SIM neutral 1'), one per SKU, no nulls — required field is satisfiable from this column.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit' matches unit.sell synonyms and values are a single unit code 'PCS' in all 12 rows, which unit_normalize maps to the enum value PCS. No pack-size evidence in the file, so /unit/pack_size is left unmapped (null) rather than guessed.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' matches price.list_name; constant value 'standard' across all 12 rows. Since the table carries exactly one price per SKU, this column identifies that single /prices entry's list name ('standard'), which the operator requirements say to use where explicitly stated.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' is an amount synonym (net price/unit price); 12 distinct numeric values, never null, range 1234.56–1356.77. Values are formatted with a '$' prefix, so parse_number_th must strip the symbol — but the '$' symbol is a currency signal that conflicts with the schema default THB, so currency remains unresolved (see notes) and the amount itself is used as-is without FX conversion.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included' matches vat_included synonyms and holds boolean-like 'No' in all 12 rows, so parse_bool yields false for every price. This is explicit source evidence of VAT-exclusive pricing (no inference from country/brand), which is what the contract requires to be stated.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate' with percent hint, constant '5%' in all 12 rows — an explicit per-row source tax rate. parse_number_th with percent_to_fraction turns '5%' into 0.05 for /prices/*/vat_rate; this is the file's stated fixture rate, not an assumed statutory rate.

clarifications.question: Prices in 'Net price' are printed with a '$' symbol (e.g. $1234.56) but the contract default is THB. Which ISO currency code should /currency carry for these amounts? Amounts are not converted.

changes_from_draft: /sku now cast to string after trim, preserving zero-padded text ids ('00470001'), per operator requirement and the approved example for similar files.
/prices/*/price_list reads the explicit 'Price list' column instead of a hard-coded constant (value is 'standard' in all 12 rows).
/prices/*/vat_included now derives from the explicit 'Tax included' column via parse_bool with a false fallback, instead of a bare constant.
Added previously unmapped /prices/*/vat_rate from the explicit 'Tax rate' column ('5%' → 0.05), which was listed as an unmatched column in the draft.
/currency kept as the contract default THB but confidence lowered to 0.5 and a single clarification raised, because 'Net price' carries a '$' symbol; no FX conversion applied.
Added explicit /status = 'active' from the contract default so the default is stated rather than implicit.
Dedupe key set to /sku on the root record; /prices deduped on /price_list.

No inventory, promotions, category, brand, barcode, description or date fields exist in the source, so they stay unmapped rather than fabricated; remaining unmapped columns are retained via attributes_passthrough.
